articles.headline: Ronald Araújo: 'Finding what I needed' at Liverpool
articles.description: Ronald Araújo is convinced his loan move to Liverpool from Barcelona was what he needed.

articles.headline: Mohamed Salah key in Rio Ngumoha's development at Liverpool - Virgil van Dijk
articles.description: Liverpool captain Virgil van Dijk has credited Mohamed Salah with helping the development of Rio Ngumoha and believes there is still "much more" to come from the teenager.

articles.headline: Alexis Mac Allister: 'Something wasn't right' under Arne Slot at Liverpool
articles.description: Alexis Mac Allister has said that Andoni Iraola fixed the issues within the Liverpool group left behind by his predecessor Arne Slot.

articles.headline: Ngumoha sparks Liverpool's comeback Champions League win
articles.description: Still just 18, Rio Ngumoha produced the finest game of his Liverpool career thus far in helping the Reds overturn a two-goal deficit vs. Villarreal.

articles.headline: Rio Ngumoha revels in 'one of his best' performances after Anfield ovation
articles.description: Rio Ngumoha has said his performance in Liverpool's 4-3 victory over Villarreal was "one of the best" of his career and said it was a "dream" to receive a standing ovation at Anfield.

articles.headline: Leboeuf hails Ngumoha after Liverpool's comeback vs. Villarreal
articles.description: Leboeuf hails Ngumoha after Liverpool's comeback vs. Villarreal

articles.headline: Liverpool 4-3 Villarreal: Mac Allister scores brace as Iraola's side come from behind to win
articles.description: Liverpool host Villarreal in the third game week of the Champions League and they look to maintain their unbeaten start to the competition and you can follow all the action with ESPN.

articles.headline: Mac Allister, Ngumoha lead Liverpool rally to stay perfect in UCL
articles.description: Teenage winger Rio Ngumoha announced himself to the Champions League as Liverpool extended their 100% record the hard way as they came from two goals down to beat Villarreal 4-3.

articles.headline: Steven Gerrard: 'No regrets' over ignoring Real Madrid, Inter Milan, Bayern Munich interest
articles.description: Former Liverpool captain Steven Gerrard has said he has "no regrets" about turning down moves to other European giants, including Real Madrid, during his playing career.

articles.headline: Champions League Power Rankings before MD3: Who's No. 1?
articles.description: It's time for the UEFA Champions League! It has been about six weeks since our last check-in, but our panel of experts and voters will rank the top 10 teams in the field. Where does your club rank?

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona, Liverpool, Real Madrid eye Jeltsch
articles.description: Barcelona, Liverpool and Real Madrid are keen on VfB Stuttgart defender Finn Jeltsch. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Brentford contact police over 'dangerous' rugby ball stunt in Liverpool game
articles.description: Brentford have contacted police following a "dangerous" and "potentially very harmful" incident which involved an "item being kicked from a height towards the field of play" in their 2-1 defeat against Liverpool.

articles.headline: Ronald Araújo: 'Too early' to say if Liverpool stay will become permanent
articles.description: Ronald Araújo has said he is "really happy" to be at Liverpool but it is "too early" to say whether he will make his loan move from Barcelona permanent.

articles.headline: Liverpool come from behind to beat shorthanded Brentford
articles.description: Victor Muñoz and Alexander Isak take advantage of a weakened Brentford defence to score a pair of electric goals and lift Liverpool to a 2-1 comeback victory.

articles.headline: Who are the top scorers in Premier League history?
articles.description: Alan Shearer has scored the most goals in Premier League history. Which other players are at the top of the list? Check out the breakdown now.

articles.headline: Nicol: Isak needs to contribute more for Liverpool despite winner vs. Brentford
articles.description: Nicol: Isak needs to contribute more for Liverpool despite winner vs. Brentford

articles.headline: Andoni Iraola questions VAR; says Szoboszlai, Frimpong out 'for some time'
articles.description: Andoni Iraola questioned the decision to overturn a penalty awarded to Liverpool in the first half of their 2-1 win at Brentford and shared injury concerns over Dominic Szoboszlai and Jeremie Frimpong after both were forced off.

articles.headline: Liverpool's front four gets a little more fab, but remains a work in progress
articles.description: Alexander Isak, Florian Wirtz, Bradley Barcola and Víctor Muñoz showed signs of understanding one another on Saturday.

articles.headline: Premier League VAR review: Should Brentford's Yarmoliuk have been sent off vs. Liverpool?
articles.description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.

articles.headline: Alexander Isak completes Liverpool comeback at nine-man Brentford
articles.description: Alexander Isak marked his return from injury with the winner as Liverpool came from behind to beat nine-man Brentford 2-1.
